Before the weekly report goes out, I check the main figures against the system rather than just reading it back.

Step 4 is where it becomes final since it sends automatically, so the gate belongs there, checking that the stock match and quantities look right before anything goes out. Step 1 matters too, since a bad read there feeds everything after it.
